{{Quote|Let me tell you something about Crimson Phoenix. This unit was designed to be the best. Do you hear me? THE BEST. I don't tolerate anything less from my pilots.|General Ufwol, to a pilot|<ref name="SWG" />}}
'''Ufwol''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[General/Legends|General]] who lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], he was present at the [[Zephyr Base]] on [[Rori/Legends|Rori]].<ref name="SWG" />
